system.description: Spending a Blood Trait, the vampire engages the target in a Social Challenge. On success, the target's mind loops through a mundane, uneventful event she personally witnessed recently, leaving her motionless and insensible for one minute (extended 10 minutes per additional Blood Trait spent). The event must require no interaction and cannot be distressing or the power fails. Any loss of health levels ends the trance immediately; a shout, gunshot, or firm nudge will also rouse the victim, though quiet speech will not.
system.duration: One minute (+10 min per extra Blood Trait)
